title: Tabiat, hayvonlar va atrof-muhit
goal_uz: Dars oxirida tabiatdagi bir joyni kamida 6 ta gap bilan tasvirlaysiz, 10 ta hayvon nomini to‘g‘ri ko‘plikda ishlatasiz, nimani yoqtirishingiz va nimadan qo‘rqishingizni aytasiz hamda atrof-muhitni asrash bo‘yicha 3 ta maslahat berasiz.

scenes.title: Tabiat darsiga xush kelibsiz
scenes.say_native: Assalomu alaykum! Yana uchrashganimizdan xursandman. Oldingi darsda “and”, “but”, “because” va “so” bog‘lovchilari bilan gaplarni ulashni o‘rgandik. Bugun ularni tabiat haqida gapirishda ishlatamiz.
scenes.say: Hello and welcome! Today we are going outside. We will talk about mountains, rivers, animals and our planet.
scenes.say_uz: Salom va xush kelibsiz! Bugun tashqariga chiqamiz. Tog‘lar, daryolar, hayvonlar va sayyoramiz haqida gaplashamiz.

scenes.title: Tabiat: asosiy joylar

examples.t: There is a river in the valley.
The forest is near the lake.

scenes.say_native: Avval eng kerakli so‘zlar. “Mountain” — tog‘, “hill” — tepalik, ya’ni kichikroq tog‘. “River” — daryo, “lake” — ko‘l. “Forest” — o‘rmon, “field” — dala. “Desert” — cho‘l, sahro. “Valley” — vodiy, masalan, Farg‘ona vodiysi inglizcha “the Fergana Valley” bo‘ladi.
scenes.say: Mountain. Hill. River. Lake. Forest. Field. Desert. Valley. There is a river in the valley.
scenes.say_uz: Tog‘. Tepalik. Daryo. Ko‘l. O‘rmon. Dala. Cho‘l. Vodiy. Vodiyda daryo bor.

scenes.title: Suv va osmon so‘zlari

examples.t: We swam in the sea.
The waterfall is very beautiful.

scenes.say_native: Davom etamiz. “Sea” — dengiz, “beach” — sohil yoki plyaj. “Island” — orol. Bu so‘zda “s” harfi umuman o‘qilmaydi: “AY-lend”. “Waterfall” — sharshara, u ikki so‘zdan yasalgan: “water” — suv va “fall” — tushmoq. “Sky” — osmon, “cloud” — bulut. Bilib qo‘ying: “beach” va “sea” so‘zlarida uzun “i:” tovushi bor.
scenes.say: Sea. Beach. Island. Waterfall. Sky. Cloud. Listen: island, island. Beach, beach.
scenes.say_uz: Dengiz. Sohil. Orol. Sharshara. Osmon. Bulut. Tinglang: orol, orol. Sohil, sohil.

scenes.title: Sanaladigan va sanalmaydigan
board: countable: a tree, two trees, a flower

examples.t: There are some trees and a lot of grass.
examples.uz: U yerda bir nechta daraxt va ko‘p o‘t bor.

examples.t: The air is fresh.

scenes.say_native: Tabiat so‘zlarida grammatik nozik bir narsa bor. Daraxt, gul, tosh sanaladi: “a tree, two trees”, “a flower, three flowers”, “a stone”. Lekin “grass” — o‘t-o‘lan, “sand” — qum, “water” — suv, “air” — havo sanalmaydi. Ularning oldiga “a” qo‘yilmaydi va ko‘plik qo‘shimchasi qo‘shilmaydi.
scenes.say: A tree, two trees. A flower, three flowers. But: grass, sand, water, air. The air is fresh and the grass is green.
scenes.say_uz: Bitta daraxt, ikkita daraxt. Bitta gul, uchta gul. Lekin: o‘t, qum, suv, havo. Havo toza, o‘t yashil.

scenes.title: The nature — xato
scenes.say_native: Eng ko‘p uchraydigan xato: “I love the nature”. Umumiy ma’nodagi “nature” so‘zi oldida artikl ishlatilmaydi: “I love nature”, “Nature is beautiful”. Rus tilida ham, o‘zbek tilida ham artikl yo‘q, shuning uchun ko‘pchilik “the” ni tasodifiy qo‘yadi.
scenes.say: Not: I love the nature. Say: I love nature. And: I go to the mountains. I swim in the sea.
scenes.say_uz: “I love the nature” emas. “I love nature” deng. Va: men tog‘larga boraman. Dengizda suzaman.

scenes.title: Qaysi so‘z?
scenes.say_native: Mashq. Ekranda to‘rtta ta’rif bor. Har biriga mos so‘zni toping. Birinchisi — juda baland yer. Ikkinchisi — birga o‘sgan ko‘p daraxtlar. Uchinchisi — issiq, quruq, qumli yer. To‘rtinchisi — baland qoyalardan suv tushadigan joy. So‘zlarni baland ovozda ayting va urg‘uga e’tibor bering.
scenes.say: Number one: very high land. Number two: a lot of trees together. Number three: hot, dry land with sand. Number four: water falls from high rocks.
scenes.say_uz: Birinchi: juda baland yer. Ikkinchi: birga o‘sgan ko‘p daraxtlar. Uchinchi: issiq, quruq, qumli yer. To‘rtinchi: baland qoyalardan suv tushadi.

scenes.title: Javoblar
scenes.say_native: Javoblar: birinchisi — “a mountain”, tog‘. Ikkinchisi — “a forest”, o‘rmon. Uchinchisi — “a desert”, cho‘l. Qizilqum — inglizchada “the Kyzylkum Desert”. To‘rtinchisi — “a waterfall”, sharshara. Agar “desert” ni “DE-zert” deb, urg‘uni birinchi bo‘g‘inga qo‘ygan bo‘lsangiz, juda yaxshi.
scenes.say: A mountain. A forest. A desert. A waterfall.
scenes.say_uz: Tog‘. O‘rmon. Cho‘l. Sharshara.

scenes.title: Hayvonlar: uy va yovvoyi
board: farm animals: cow, sheep, goat, horse, chicken
wild animals: wolf, bear, fox, eagle, snake

examples.t: My grandfather has ten sheep.
Wolves live in the mountains.

scenes.say_native: Endi hayvonlar. Ularni uch guruhga bo‘lamiz. “Pets” — uy hayvonlari, uyda boqiladiganlar: “cat” — mushuk, “dog” — it, “parrot” — to‘tiqush. “Farm animals” — chorva va parranda: “cow” — sigir, “sheep” — qo‘y, “goat” — echki, “horse” — ot, “chicken” — tovuq.
scenes.say: Pets: a cat, a dog, a parrot. Farm animals: a cow, a sheep, a goat, a horse, a chicken. Wild animals: a wolf, a bear, a fox, an eagle, a snake, a camel.
scenes.say_uz: Uy hayvonlari: mushuk, it, to‘tiqush. Chorva: sigir, qo‘y, echki, ot, tovuq. Yovvoyi hayvonlar: bo‘ri, ayiq, tulki, burgut, ilon, tuya.

scenes.title: Noodatiy ko‘plik shakllari

examples.t: There are fifty sheep on the hill.
I saw two mice in the kitchen.

scenes.say_native: O‘zbek tilida ko‘plik juda oddiy: har doim “-lar”. Ingliz tilida esa ba’zi hayvon nomlari noodatiy. “Sheep” — bitta qo‘y ham, ko‘p qo‘y ham “sheep”. “Fish” ham shunday: “I caught three fish.” “Mouse” — sichqon, ko‘pligi “mice”. “Goose” — g‘oz, ko‘pligi “geese”.
scenes.say: One sheep, ten sheep. One fish, three fish. One mouse, two mice. One goose, five geese. One wolf, two wolves.
scenes.say_uz: Bitta qo‘y, o‘nta qo‘y. Bitta baliq, uchta baliq. Bitta sichqon, ikkita sichqon. Bitta g‘oz, beshta g‘oz. Bitta bo‘ri, ikkita bo‘ri.

scenes.title: Sheeps va mouses yo‘q
scenes.say_native: Bu xatoni ko‘p eshitaman: “My uncle has twenty sheeps.” To‘g‘risi — “twenty sheep”, “s” siz. Xuddi shunday “mouses” emas, “mice”, “wolfs” emas, “wolves”. Nega shunday? Bu so‘zlar ingliz tilining juda qadimgi shakllarini saqlab qolgan, ularda qoida yo‘q, faqat yodlash kerak.
scenes.say: Not: twenty sheeps. Say: twenty sheep. Not mouses, but mice. Not wolfs, but wolves.
scenes.say_uz: “Twenty sheeps” emas, “twenty sheep”. “Mouses” emas, “mice”. “Wolfs” emas, “wolves”.

scenes.title: Hayvonlar qayerda yashaydi
board: in the forest · in the desert · in the sea
in the mountains · in a river
on a farm · on the beach

examples.t: Camels live in the desert.
Cows live on a farm.

scenes.say_native: Hayvon qayerda yashashini aytish uchun “live” fe’li va old ko‘makchi kerak. Ko‘p joylar “in” bilan: “in the forest”, “in the desert”, “in the sea”, “in the mountains”, “in a river”. Ya’ni biror narsaning ichida. Lekin ikki muhim istisno: “on a farm” — fermada va “on the beach” — sohilda.
scenes.say: Bears live in the forest. Camels live in the desert. Fish live in the sea. Cows live on a farm. We play on the beach.
scenes.say_uz: Ayiqlar o‘rmonda yashaydi. Tuyalar cho‘lda yashaydi. Baliqlar dengizda yashaydi. Sigirlar fermada yashaydi. Biz sohilda o‘ynaymiz.

scenes.title: In a farm — xato
board: ✗ in a farm → ✓ on a farm
✗ in the beach → ✓ on the beach
scenes.say_native: O‘zbek tilida “fermada”, “sohilda”, “dengizda” — hammasi bir xil “-da”. Shuning uchun “in a farm”, “in the beach” degan xatolar ko‘p bo‘ladi. Eslab qoling: “on a farm”, “on the beach”. Agar suvning ichida bo‘lsangiz yoki baliq haqida gapirsangiz — “in the sea”. Sohilda qumda yotgan bo‘lsangiz — “on the beach”.
scenes.say: The children are on the beach, and their father is in the sea. My grandparents live on a farm.
scenes.say_uz: Bolalar sohilda, otasi esa dengizda. Buvim va bobom fermada yashaydi.

scenes.title: To‘ldiring
scenes.say_native: Endi to‘rtta gapni to‘ldiring. Birinchi va to‘rtinchi gapda qavs ichidagi so‘zni to‘g‘ri ko‘plik shakliga qo‘ying. Ikkinchi va uchinchi gapda to‘g‘ri old ko‘makchini tanlang: “in” yoki “on”. Shoshilmang, har bir gapni to‘liq baland ovozda o‘qing. Javobni daftaringizga yozib qo‘ysangiz, yanada yaxshi.
scenes.say: Complete the sentences. Number one: three … sheep. Two: camels live … the desert. Three: horses live … a farm. Four: two … mouse.
scenes.say_uz: Gaplarni to‘ldiring. Bir: uchta qo‘y. Ikki: tuyalar cho‘lda yashaydi. Uch: otlar fermada yashaydi. To‘rt: ikkita sichqon.

scenes.title: Javoblar
scenes.say_native: Javoblarni tekshiramiz. Birinchi: “I can see three sheep” — “s” siz. Ikkinchi: “Camels live in the desert” — “in”. Uchinchi: “Horses live on a farm” — “on”, chunki ferma ochiq maydon. To‘rtinchi: “We saw two mice.” Agar to‘rttasi ham to‘g‘ri bo‘lsa, zo‘r.
scenes.say: I can see three sheep. Camels live in the desert. Horses live on a farm. We saw two mice.
scenes.say_uz: Uchta qo‘yni ko‘ryapman. Tuyalar cho‘lda yashaydi. Otlar fermada yashaydi. Biz ikkita sichqon ko‘rdik.

scenes.title: Manzarani tasvirlash: sifatlar
board: deep lake · wide river · rocky hill

examples.t: The mountains are high and snowy.
It's a quiet, peaceful place.

scenes.say_native: Endi ikkinchi katta mavzu: manzarani tasvirlash. Buning uchun sifatlar kerak. Tog‘ uchun “high” — baland, daraxt va odam uchun ko‘pincha “tall” — baland bo‘yli. Ko‘l uchun “deep” — chuqur, daryo uchun “wide” — keng.
scenes.say: High, snowy mountains. Tall green trees. A deep blue lake. A wide river. It's a quiet, peaceful place.
scenes.say_uz: Baland, qorli tog‘lar. Baland yashil daraxtlar. Chuqur moviy ko‘l. Keng daryo. Bu sokin, osoyishta joy.

scenes.title: There is / There are bilan tasvir

examples.t: There is a small village in the valley.
There are a lot of flowers in spring.

scenes.say_native: Manzarani tasvirlashning eng qulay usuli — “there is” va “there are”. Birlikdagi yoki sanalmaydigan narsa uchun “there is”: “There is a lake”, “There is a lot of snow.” Ko‘plik uchun “there are”: “There are tall trees.” Og‘zaki nutqda “there is” deyarli doim qisqarib, “there’s” bo‘ladi.
scenes.say: There's a small village in the valley. There are tall trees near the river. There's a lot of snow on the mountains.
scenes.say_uz: Vodiyda kichik qishloq bor. Daryo yonida baland daraxtlar bor. Tog‘larda ko‘p qor bor.

scenes.title: Joylashuv iboralari
board: in the middle (o‘rtada) · in the distance (uzoqda)
on the left / on the right
at the foot of the mountain (tog‘ etagida)

examples.t: In the distance, there are high mountains.
There's a house at the foot of the mountain.

scenes.say_native: Tasvir jonli bo‘lishi uchun narsalar qayerda ekanini ayting. “In the middle” — o‘rtada. “In the distance” — uzoqda. “On the left” va “on the right” — chapda va o‘ngda. “At the foot of the mountain” — tog‘ etagida, so‘zma-so‘z “tog‘ning oyog‘ida”. Qiziq, o‘zbekchada “etak”, inglizchada “oyoq”.
scenes.say: In the middle, there's a lake. On the left, there's a forest. In the distance, there are high mountains. There's a small house at the foot of the mountain.
scenes.say_uz: O‘rtada ko‘l bor. Chapda o‘rmon bor. Uzoqda baland tog‘lar bor. Tog‘ etagida kichik uy bor.

scenes.title: Namuna: Chorvoqda
scenes.say_native: Endi to‘liq namunani tinglang. Bu Toshkent yaqinidagi Chorvoq suv omborining tasviri. Qulog‘ingizni “there is”, “there are”, sifatlar va joylashuv iboralariga tuting. E’tibor bering, gaplar qisqa va oddiy, lekin birga yaxshi rasm hosil qiladi. Bunday tasvirni siz ham bugun tuza olasiz.
scenes.say: This is Charvak. It's about two hours from Tashkent. In the middle, there's a big blue lake. There are high mountains all around it, and in spring they are still snowy. On the left, there's a small beach. The air is fresh and it's very quiet. It's a peaceful place.
scenes.say_uz: Bu Chorvoq. U Toshkentdan taxminan ikki soatlik yo‘lda. O‘rtada katta moviy ko‘l bor. Atrofida baland tog‘lar bor, bahorda ular hali ham qorli bo‘ladi. Chapda kichik sohil bor. Havo toza va juda jimjit. Bu osoyishta joy.

scenes.title: There is many trees — xato
board: ✗ a lake blue → ✓ a blue lake
scenes.say_native: Ikki xatoga e’tibor bering. Birinchisi: ko‘plik bilan “there is” ishlatish: “There is many trees.” To‘g‘risi — “There are many trees.” Ikkinchisi: sifatni otdan keyin qo‘yish, masalan “a lake blue”. Bu xato ko‘pincha fransuz yoki ispan tilini o‘rganganlarda uchraydi, lekin ba’zan bizda ham bo‘ladi.
scenes.say: Not: There is many trees. Say: There are many trees. Not: a lake blue. Say: a blue lake.
scenes.say_uz: “There is many trees” emas, “There are many trees”. “A lake blue” emas, “a blue lake”.

scenes.title: Manzarani to‘ldiring
board: 2) There ___ two big trees on the right.
4) There's a village ___ the foot of the hill.
scenes.say_native: To‘rtta gapni to‘ldiring. Birinchi va ikkinchi gapda “is” yoki “are” ni tanlang. Uchinchi gapda “keng” ma’nosidagi sifatni ayting. To‘rtinchi gapda tog‘ yoki tepalik etagini bildiradigan iborani to‘ldiring. Har bir gapni to‘liq ayting, faqat bitta so‘z emas.
scenes.say: Complete: There … a small lake. There … two big trees on the right. The river is very … There's a village … the foot of the hill.
scenes.say_uz: To‘ldiring: kichik ko‘l bor. O‘ngda ikkita katta daraxt bor. Daryo juda keng. Tepalik etagida qishloq bor.

scenes.title: Javoblar
board: 4) at the foot of the hill
scenes.say_native: Javoblar: birinchi — “There is a small lake”, qisqasi “There’s”. Ikkinchi — “There are two big trees on the right”, chunki “trees” ko‘plikda. Uchinchi — “The river is very wide.” Agar “big” degan bo‘lsangiz, bu ham noto‘g‘ri emas, lekin daryo uchun “wide” aniqroq.
scenes.say: There's a small lake. There are two big trees on the right. The river is very wide. There's a village at the foot of the hill.
scenes.say_uz: Kichik ko‘l bor. O‘ngda ikkita katta daraxt bor. Daryo juda keng. Tepalik etagida qishloq bor.

scenes.title: Dialog 1: Hafta oxiri tog‘da
board: Where? What did they see? Weather?
scenes.say_native: Birinchi dialogni tinglang. Aziza va uning ingliz do‘sti Tom dushanba kuni ishda gaplashyapti. Tom hafta oxirini tog‘da o‘tkazgan. Tinglang va uchta narsani eslab qoling: Tom qayerga borgan, u yerda qaysi hayvonlarni ko‘rgan va havo qanday bo‘lgan. Dialog o‘tgan zamonda, bu zamonni oldingi darslardan bilasiz.
scenes.say: Aziza: Hi Tom! How was your weekend? Tom: Great! I went to Chimgan with some friends. Aziza: Oh, lovely! What was it like? Tom: Beautiful. There were snowy mountains and a little river. We saw an eagle and some goats on the rocks. Aziza: Wow! Was it cold? Tom: Yes, a bit, but it was sunny, so we walked all day.
scenes.say_uz: Aziza: Salom Tom! Dam olish kunlari qanday o‘tdi? Tom: Zo‘r! Do‘stlar bilan Chimyonga bordim. Aziza: Voy, ajoyib! U yer qanday ekan? Tom: Chiroyli. Qorli tog‘lar va kichik daryo bor edi. Qoyalarda burgut va bir nechta echki ko‘rdik. Aziza: Voy! Sovuq edimi? Tom: Ha, sal sovuq edi, lekin quyoshli edi, shuning uchun kun bo‘yi yurdik.

scenes.title: Dialog bo‘yicha savollar
board: 4) Why did they walk all day?
scenes.say_native: Endi savollarga javob bering. Tom qayerga bordi? Qaysi hayvonlarni ko‘rdi? Havo sovuq edimi? Nima uchun ular kun bo‘yi yurishdi? Oxirgi savolga javob berishda dialogdagi “so” bog‘lovchisini eslang. Javoblarni baland ovozda, to‘liq gap bilan ayting. Kerak bo‘lsa, dialogni yana bir marta tinglang.
scenes.say: Where did Tom go? What animals did he see? Was it cold? Why did they walk all day?
scenes.say_uz: Tom qayerga bordi? Qaysi hayvonlarni ko‘rdi? Sovuq edimi? Nima uchun ular kun bo‘yi yurishdi?

scenes.title: Javoblar
scenes.say_native: Javoblar: Tom Chimyonga bordi — “He went to Chimgan.” U burgut va bir nechta echkini ko‘rdi — “an eagle and some goats”. Ha, havo sal sovuq edi — “a bit cold”. Ular kun bo‘yi yurishdi, chunki havo quyoshli edi. Dialogda “it was sunny, so we walked all day” deyildi.
scenes.say: He went to Chimgan. He saw an eagle and some goats. Yes, it was a bit cold. They walked all day because it was sunny.
scenes.say_uz: U Chimyonga bordi. Burgut va bir nechta echki ko‘rdi. Ha, sal sovuq edi. Ular kun bo‘yi yurishdi, chunki quyoshli edi.

scenes.title: Yoqtirish: like, love, enjoy
board: I like walking in the forest. (fe’l + -ing)
I enjoy swimming in the lake.

examples.t: I love horses.
She enjoys watching birds.

scenes.say_native: Uchinchi mavzu: yoqtirish va qo‘rqish. “Like” — yoqtirmoq, “love” — juda yaxshi ko‘rmoq, “enjoy” — zavq olmoq. Ulardan keyin ot keladi: “I love animals.” Agar harakat haqida gapirsangiz, fe’lga “-ing” qo‘shiladi: “I like walking in the forest”, “I enjoy swimming.”
scenes.say: I love animals. I like walking in the forest. I enjoy swimming in the lake. My sister enjoys watching birds.
scenes.say_uz: Men hayvonlarni juda yaxshi ko‘raman. O‘rmonda yurishni yoqtiraman. Ko‘lda suzishdan zavq olaman. Singlim qushlarni kuzatishni yoqtiradi.

scenes.title: Yoqtirish darajalari

examples.t: I don't mind spiders.
I can't stand mosquitoes.

scenes.say_native: Fikringizni aniqroq aytish uchun darajalarni biling. Eng kuchlisi “love”, keyin “really like”, “like”. O‘rtada “don’t mind” — qarshi emasman, menga farqi yo‘q. Keyin “don’t like” — yoqtirmayman. Eng salbiysi “hate” — nafratlanaman va “can’t stand” — chiday olmayman.
scenes.say: I love dogs. I really like horses. I don't mind spiders. I don't like rats. I can't stand mosquitoes.
scenes.say_uz: Itlarni juda yaxshi ko‘raman. Otlarni juda yoqtiraman. O‘rgimchaklarga qarshi emasman. Kalamushlarni yoqtirmayman. Chivinlarga chiday olmayman.

scenes.title: I like cat — xato
scenes.say_native: Umuman biror hayvon turini yoqtirishingiz haqida gapirganda ot ko‘plikda va artiklsiz bo‘ladi: “I like cats”, “I’m afraid of dogs.” O‘zbekchada “Mushukni yaxshi ko‘raman” deymiz, birlikda, shuning uchun “I like cat” degan xato juda ko‘p.
scenes.say: Not: I like cat. Say: I like cats. I love horses. I love snow.
scenes.say_uz: “I like cat” emas, “I like cats” deng. Otlarni yaxshi ko‘raman. Qorni yaxshi ko‘raman.

scenes.title: Qo‘rquv: afraid of, scared of
board: I'm afraid of swimming in deep water.

examples.t: My brother is scared of dogs.
Are you afraid of the dark?

scenes.say_native: Endi qo‘rquv haqida. Ingliz tilida “qo‘rqmoq” ko‘pincha fe’l emas, sifat bilan aytiladi: “be afraid of” yoki “be scared of”. Ya’ni “I am afraid of snakes” — men ilondan qo‘rqaman. “Scared” sal og‘zakiroq. Undan keyin ot yoki “-ing” shakli keladi: “I’m afraid of swimming in deep water.” Savol: “Are you afraid of the dark?”
scenes.say: I'm afraid of snakes. My brother is scared of dogs. Are you afraid of the dark? I'm afraid of swimming in deep water.
scenes.say_uz: Men ilonlardan qo‘rqaman. Akam itlardan qo‘rqadi. Qorong‘ilikdan qo‘rqasizmi? Men chuqur suvda suzishdan qo‘rqaman.

scenes.title: Afraid from — xato
scenes.say_native: Bu yerda ikki xato bor. Birinchisi: “am” ni tushirib qoldirish — “I afraid snakes.” “Afraid” sifat, shuning uchun “am, is, are” kerak. Ikkinchisi: o‘zbekchadagi “-dan” qo‘shimchasini “from” deb tarjima qilish: “I’m afraid from snakes.” Ingliz tilida qo‘rquvdan keyin doim “of” keladi.
scenes.say: Not: I afraid snakes. Not: I'm afraid from snakes. Say: I'm afraid of snakes.
scenes.say_uz: “I afraid snakes” emas. “I'm afraid from snakes” emas. “I'm afraid of snakes” deng.

scenes.title: Xatoni tuzating
board: 3) I enjoy swim in the sea.
scenes.say_native: To‘rtta gapda bittadan xato bor. Har birini topib, to‘g‘ri shaklini baland ovozda ayting. Maslahat: birinchi gapda old ko‘makchiga, ikkinchisida ko‘plikka, uchinchisida fe’l shakliga, to‘rtinchisida artiklga qarang. Bugun o‘rgangan qoidalarning hammasi shu yerda.
scenes.say: Find the mistakes. One: I'm afraid from dogs. Two: I like horse. Three: I enjoy swim in the sea. Four: I love the nature.
scenes.say_uz: Xatolarni toping. Bir: itlardan qo‘rqaman. Ikki: otni yoqtiraman. Uch: dengizda suzishni yoqtiraman. To‘rt: tabiatni yaxshi ko‘raman.

scenes.title: Javoblar
board: 3) I enjoy swimming in the sea.
scenes.say_native: To‘g‘ri javoblar: birinchi — “I’m afraid of dogs”, “from” emas “of”. Ikkinchi — “I like horses”, umumiy ma’noda ko‘plik. Uchinchi — “I enjoy swimming in the sea”, “enjoy” dan keyin “-ing”. To‘rtinchi — “I love nature”, artiklsiz. To‘rttasini topgan bo‘lsangiz, siz bu mavzuni yaxshi tushundingiz.
scenes.say: I'm afraid of dogs. I like horses. I enjoy swimming in the sea. I love nature.
scenes.say_uz: Itlardan qo‘rqaman. Otlarni yoqtiraman. Dengizda suzishdan zavq olaman. Tabiatni yaxshi ko‘raman.

scenes.title: O‘zingiz haqingizda
board: 3) Something you enjoy doing in nature
scenes.say_native: Endi o‘zingiz haqingizda gapiring. Uchta gap tuzing. Birinchi: qaysi hayvonni yaxshi ko‘rasiz va nega — “because” bilan. Ikkinchi: qaysi hayvondan qo‘rqasiz. Uchinchi: tabiatda nima qilishni yoqtirasiz, “-ing” shakli bilan. Oldingi darsdagi bog‘lovchilarni ishlatishga harakat qiling.
scenes.say: Tell me about you. Which animal do you love, and why? Which animal are you afraid of? What do you enjoy doing in nature?
scenes.say_uz: O‘zingiz haqingizda ayting. Qaysi hayvonni yaxshi ko‘rasiz va nega? Qaysi hayvondan qo‘rqasiz? Tabiatda nima qilishni yoqtirasiz?

scenes.title: Namuna javoblar
board: I love horses because they're strong and beautiful.
I enjoy walking in the mountains.
scenes.say_native: Namuna javoblarni tinglang va o‘zingiznikini solishtiring. “I love horses because they’re strong and beautiful.” “I’m scared of snakes, but I don’t mind spiders.” “I enjoy walking in the mountains with my family.”
scenes.say: I love horses because they're strong and beautiful. I'm scared of snakes, but I don't mind spiders. I enjoy walking in the mountains with my family.
scenes.say_uz: Otlarni yaxshi ko‘raman, chunki ular kuchli va chiroyli. Ilonlardan qo‘rqaman, lekin o‘rgimchaklarga qarshi emasman. Oilam bilan tog‘larda yurishni yoqtiraman.

scenes.title: Atrof-muhit: asosiy so‘zlar

examples.t: Pollution is a big problem in cities.
We recycle plastic bottles.

scenes.say_native: To‘rtinchi mavzu: atrof-muhit. “The environment” — atrof-muhit, odatda “the” bilan. “Pollution” — ifloslanish: havo ifloslanishi — “air pollution”. “Rubbish” — axlat, bu britancha so‘z, amerikaliklar “trash” yoki “garbage” deydi. “Litter” — ko‘chaga tashlab ketilgan axlat.
scenes.say: The environment. Air pollution. Rubbish, or in American English, trash. Litter. Recycle. Plastic. Climate change.
scenes.say_uz: Atrof-muhit. Havo ifloslanishi. Axlat, amerikacha — trash. Ko‘chadagi axlat. Qayta ishlash. Plastik. Iqlim o‘zgarishi.

scenes.title: Environment so‘zining talaffuzi
scenes.say_native: Talaffuzga e’tibor bering. “Environment” so‘zida urg‘u ikkinchi bo‘g‘inda: “en-VI-ron-ment”. Bu yerdagi “i” harfi “ay” deb o‘qiladi. Ko‘pchilik “envi-ROn-ment” deb, urg‘uni noto‘g‘ri qo‘yadi. “Pollution” — “po-LU-shn”, urg‘u ikkinchi bo‘g‘inda va o‘rtada uzun “u:”.
scenes.say: Environment. Environment. Pollution. Pollution. Recycle. Recycle. We must protect the environment.
scenes.say_uz: Atrof-muhit. Ifloslanish. Qayta ishlash. Biz atrof-muhitni himoya qilishimiz kerak.

scenes.title: Atrof-muhitni asrash: should
board: We should recycle. · We shouldn't drop litter.
save water · plant trees · turn off the lights

examples.t: We should use less plastic.
You shouldn't throw rubbish in the river.

scenes.say_native: Maslahat berish uchun “should” ishlatamiz. “We should recycle” — qayta ishlashimiz kerak. Inkor shakli: “shouldn’t”: “We shouldn’t drop litter” — axlat tashlamasligimiz kerak.
scenes.say: We should recycle paper and plastic. We should save water. We should plant trees. We shouldn't drop litter in parks.
scenes.say_uz: Qog‘oz va plastikni qayta ishlashimiz kerak. Suvni tejashimiz kerak. Daraxt ekishimiz kerak. Bog‘larga axlat tashlamasligimiz kerak.

scenes.title: Should to — xato
board: ✓ We should recycle. · He should save water.
scenes.say_native: “Should” bilan ikki xato ko‘p uchraydi. Birinchisi: undan keyin “to” qo‘yish — “We should to recycle.” Ehtimol, bu “have to” yoki “need to” ta’sirida bo‘ladi. Lekin “should” dan keyin to‘g‘ridan to‘g‘ri fe’l keladi. Ikkinchisi: uchinchi shaxsda “s” qo‘shish — “He shoulds.”
scenes.say: Not: We should to recycle. Say: We should recycle. Not: He shoulds. Say: He should save water.
scenes.say_uz: “We should to recycle” emas, “We should recycle”. “He shoulds” emas, “He should save water”.

scenes.title: O‘zbekiston misolida
board: The Aral Sea is much smaller now.
People took too much water for cotton fields.

examples.t: The Aral Sea was the fourth largest lake in the world.
examples.uz: Orol dengizi dunyodagi to‘rtinchi eng katta ko‘l edi.

scenes.say_native: Atrof-muhit mavzusida O‘zbekiston uchun eng muhim misol — Orol dengizi. U bir vaqtlar dunyodagi eng katta ko‘llardan biri edi, hozir esa ancha kichrayib ketgan. Asosiy sabab: Amudaryo va Sirdaryodan paxta dalalari uchun juda ko‘p suv olingan.
scenes.say: The Aral Sea was very big. Now it is much smaller, because people took too much water from the rivers for cotton fields. So we should save water.
scenes.say_uz: Orol dengizi juda katta edi. Hozir u ancha kichik, chunki odamlar paxta dalalari uchun daryolardan juda ko‘p suv olishdi. Shuning uchun suvni tejashimiz kerak.

scenes.title: Muammo va yechim
scenes.say_native: Uchta muammo bor. Har biri uchun “We should…” bilan bitta yechim ayting. Birinchi: hamma joyda plastik shishalar ko‘p. Ikkinchi: shaharda havo iflos. Uchinchi: yozda suv kam. Har bir muammoga bir nechta to‘g‘ri javob bo‘lishi mumkin, eng muhimi “should” dan keyin “to” qo‘ymang.
scenes.say: Problem one: a lot of plastic bottles. Problem two: dirty air in the city. Problem three: not much water in summer. What should we do?
scenes.say_uz: Birinchi muammo: ko‘p plastik shishalar. Ikkinchi: shaharda iflos havo. Uchinchi: yozda suv kam. Nima qilishimiz kerak?

scenes.title: Namuna javoblar
board: 1) We should recycle them. / use fewer bottles.
2) We should plant trees. / walk or cycle.
3) We should save water. / take short showers.
scenes.say_native: Mumkin bo‘lgan javoblar. Plastik shishalar: “We should recycle them” yoki “We should use fewer plastic bottles.” Iflos havo: “We should plant more trees” yoki “We should walk, cycle or take the bus.”
scenes.say: We should recycle plastic bottles. We should plant more trees and take the bus. We should save water and turn off the tap.
scenes.say_uz: Plastik shishalarni qayta ishlashimiz kerak. Ko‘proq daraxt ekib, avtobusda yurishimiz kerak. Suvni tejab, jo‘mrakni yopishimiz kerak.

scenes.title: Dialog 2: Milliy bog‘da
scenes.say_native: Ikkinchi dialog. Zomin milliy bog‘ida qo‘riqchi, inglizcha “park ranger”, sayyohlar guruhi bilan gaplashyapti. U bog‘da qaysi hayvonlar borligini va qanday qoidalar borligini aytadi. Diqqat bilan tinglang: keyin hayvonlar, qoidalar va guruh qachon qaytishi haqida so‘rayman.
scenes.say: Ranger: Good morning, everyone, and welcome to the national park! Here you can see eagles, mountain goats and, if you're lucky, a bear. Please stay on the path. Don't feed the animals, and please take your rubbish home with you. Visitor: Are there any snakes? Ranger: Yes, a few, but they're usually afraid of people. OK, we come back at four o'clock. Enjoy the walk!
scenes.say_uz: Qo‘riqchi: Hammaga xayrli tong va milliy bog‘ga xush kelibsiz! Bu yerda burgutlar, tog‘ echkilari va, omadingiz kelsa, ayiq ko‘rishingiz mumkin. Iltimos, so‘qmoqdan chiqmang. Hayvonlarni boqmang va axlatingizni o‘zingiz bilan olib keting. Sayyoh: Ilonlar bormi? Qo‘riqchi: Ha, bir nechta, lekin ular odatda odamlardan qo‘rqadi. Xo‘p, soat to‘rtda qaytamiz. Sayrdan zavqlaning!

scenes.title: Tinglab tushunish
board: 1) Name three animals in the park.
4) What time do they come back?
scenes.say_native: Savollar: bog‘dagi uchta hayvonni ayting. Qo‘riqchi aytgan ikkita qoidani ayting. Ilonlar haqida u nima dedi? Guruh soat nechada qaytadi? Qoidalarni aytayotganda buyruq shaklini ishlating: “Don’t…” yoki “Please…”. Javoblarni qisqa, lekin aniq ayting.
scenes.say: Name three animals in the park. Name two rules. What did the ranger say about snakes? What time do they come back?
scenes.say_uz: Bog‘dagi uchta hayvonni ayting. Ikkita qoidani ayting. Qo‘riqchi ilonlar haqida nima dedi? Ular soat nechada qaytadi?

scenes.title: Javoblar
board: 2) Stay on the path. Don't feed the animals.
scenes.say_native: Javoblar: hayvonlar — burgutlar, tog‘ echkilari va ayiq. Qoidalar — so‘qmoqdan chiqmaslik, hayvonlarni boqmaslik va axlatni olib ketish. Ilonlar bor, lekin ular odatda odamlardan qo‘rqadi: “they’re usually afraid of people.” Ko‘rdingizmi, “afraid of” faqat odamlar haqida emas, hayvonlar haqida ham ishlatiladi.
scenes.say: Eagles, mountain goats and a bear. Stay on the path, don't feed the animals and take your rubbish home. The snakes are usually afraid of people. They come back at four.
scenes.say_uz: Burgutlar, tog‘ echkilari va ayiq. So‘qmoqdan chiqmang, hayvonlarni boqmang va axlatni olib keting. Ilonlar odatda odamlardan qo‘rqadi. Ular soat to‘rtda qaytadi.

scenes.title: Talaffuz: kuchsiz shakllar
board: a lot of trees → /ə ˈlɒt əv/
scenes.say_native: Endi tabiiy nutq haqida. Tez nutqda “of” deyarli “ev” yoki “ə” bo‘lib qoladi: “a lot of trees” — “ə-LO-təv trees”. “Afraid of snakes” da “d” va “of” qo‘shilib ketadi: “ə-FREY-dəv snakes”. “The” artikli undosh oldida qisqa “ðə” — “the mountains”, unli tovush oldida esa “ði” — “the environment”, “the ocean”.
scenes.say: A lot of trees. A lot of trees. I'm afraid of snakes. I'm afraid of snakes. The mountains. The environment. The ocean.
scenes.say_uz: Ko‘p daraxtlar. Men ilonlardan qo‘rqaman. Tog‘lar. Atrof-muhit. Okean.

scenes.title: Takrorlang
board: There are a lot of trees.
scenes.say_native: Uchta gapni takrorlang. Har birini avval sekin, keyin tabiiy tezlikda ayting. “Of” ni alohida, kuchli aytmang, uni oldingi so‘zga ulang. Uchinchi gapda “the environment” dagi “the” ni “ði” deb ayting, chunki undan keyin unli tovush keladi. O‘zingizni telefonga yozib olib tinglasangiz, farqni yaxshiroq sezasiz.
scenes.say: There are a lot of trees. I'm afraid of spiders. We should protect the environment.
scenes.say_uz: U yerda ko‘p daraxt bor. Men o‘rgimchaklardan qo‘rqaman. Biz atrof-muhitni himoya qilishimiz kerak.

scenes.title: Talaffuzni tekshiring
scenes.say_native: O‘zingizni tekshiring. “A lot of” uchta alohida so‘zdek emas, bitta oqimdek eshitildimi: “ə-LO-təv”? “Afraid of” da “d” keyingi tovushga ulandimi? “The environment” da “ði” va urg‘u “VAY” bo‘g‘iniga tushdimi? Agar biror joyda qiynalsangiz, faqat o‘sha iborani besh marta takrorlang.
scenes.say: Listen again: a lot of, afraid of, the environment.
scenes.say_uz: Yana tinglang: ko‘p, qo‘rqaman, atrof-muhit.

scenes.title: Tasvir rejasi
board: 1) Where is it? What's it called?
2) What can you see? (There is / are)
3) Animals? What do you do there?
4) How do you feel? Why? (because / so)
scenes.say_native: Endi uyga vazifaga tayyorlanamiz. Tabiatdagi sevimli joyingizni to‘rt qadamda tasvirlang. Birinchi: bu joy qayerda va qanday ataladi. Ikkinchi: u yerda nima bor — “there is”, “there are” va sifatlar bilan. Uchinchi: u yerda qaysi hayvonlar bor va siz nima qilasiz — “I enjoy walking”.
scenes.say: Where is it? What can you see? Are there any animals? What do you do there? How do you feel, and why?
scenes.say_uz: U qayerda? Nimani ko‘rasiz? Hayvonlar bormi? U yerda nima qilasiz? O‘zingizni qanday his qilasiz va nega?

scenes.title: Sevimli joyingizni tasvirlang
board: My favourite place in nature is…
I enjoy… · I love it because…
scenes.say_native: Eng muhim mashq. Ekrandagi rejaga qarab, tabiatdagi sevimli joyingizni kamida beshta gap bilan tasvirlang. Bu tog‘, ko‘l, bog‘ yoki qishlog‘ingizdagi daryo bo‘lishi mumkin. Kamida bitta “there are”, bitta “enjoy + -ing” va bitta “because” ishlating. Baland ovozda gapiring, xato qilishdan qo‘rqmang.
scenes.say: Now describe your favourite place in nature. Use at least five sentences. Start!
scenes.say_uz: Endi tabiatdagi sevimli joyingizni tasvirlang. Kamida beshta gap ishlating. Boshlang!

scenes.title: Namuna tasvir
board: My favourite place is my grandfather's village.
There's a wide river and there are tall trees.
I love it because it's quiet, so I feel relaxed.
scenes.say_native: Namunani tinglang va o‘z javobingiz bilan solishtiring. Bunda reja to‘liq bajarilgan: joy nomi, “there is” va “there are”, sifatlar, hayvonlar, “enjoy + -ing”, “because” va “so”. Sizning javobingizda ham shu elementlar bo‘lsa, siz bugungi maqsadga erishdingiz. Bo‘lmasa, yetishmagan qismini qo‘shib, yana bir bor ayting.
scenes.say: My favourite place in nature is my grandfather's village near Zaamin. There's a wide river, and there are tall trees and green fields. There are a lot of sheep and goats on the hills. I enjoy walking by the river in the morning. I love it because it's quiet and the air is fresh, so I always feel relaxed there.
scenes.say_uz: Tabiatdagi sevimli joyim — Zomin yaqinidagi bobomning qishlog‘i. U yerda keng daryo, baland daraxtlar va yashil dalalar bor. Tepaliklarda ko‘p qo‘y va echkilar bor. Ertalab daryo bo‘yida yurishni yoqtiraman. U yerni yaxshi ko‘raman, chunki u jimjit va havosi toza, shuning uchun u yerda doim xotirjam bo‘laman.

scenes.title: Bugun nimani o‘rgandik
board: mountain, river, forest, desert · sheep → sheep, mouse → mice
There are tall trees. · on a farm, in the forest
I love / enjoy + -ing · afraid of + noun
scenes.say_native: Xulosa qilamiz. Tabiatdagi joylar va hayvonlar nomlarini, “sheep”, “mice”, “wolves” kabi noodatiy ko‘pliklarni o‘rgandik. “On a farm”, lekin “in the forest” ekanini bildik. Manzarani “there is”, “there are”, sifatlar va joylashuv iboralari bilan tasvirladik.
scenes.say: Great work today! You can now describe nature, talk about animals you like and fear, and give simple advice about the environment.
scenes.say_uz: Bugun zo‘r ishladingiz! Endi tabiatni tasvirlay olasiz, yoqtirgan va qo‘rqadigan hayvonlaringiz haqida gapira olasiz va atrof-muhit haqida oddiy maslahat bera olasiz.

scenes.title: Uyga vazifa
board: Describe a place in nature you love.
scenes.say_native: Uyga vazifa: tabiatda o‘zingiz yaxshi ko‘radigan joyni tasvirlang. Sakkizdan o‘ngacha gap yozing yoki bir daqiqalik ovoz yozib oling.
scenes.say: Your homework: describe a place in nature you love. See you next time!
scenes.say_uz: Uyga vazifa: tabiatda yaxshi ko‘radigan joyingizni tasvirlang. Keyingi safar ko‘rishguncha!

homework_uz: Tabiatda o‘zingiz yaxshi ko‘radigan joyni 8–10 gap bilan tasvirlang yoki 1 daqiqalik ovoz yozib oling. Mezon: kamida 5 ta tabiat so‘zi, there is va there are, 2 ta sifat, enjoy/love + -ing, because yoki so bilan sabab; “the nature” deb yozilmagan.

quiz.why_uz: Umumiy ma’nodagi nature artiklsiz ishlatiladi: I love nature.

quiz.q: Cows and horses live ___ a farm.

quiz.why_uz: Qo‘rquv: be afraid of. “-dan” ni from deb tarjima qilmang va am ni tushirib qoldirmang.

quiz.q: There ___ a lot of tall trees near the lake.
quiz.why_uz: Trees — ko‘plik, shuning uchun there are.
Enjoy dan keyin fe’l -ing shaklida keladi.

quiz.q: Hot, dry land with a lot of sand is a ___.

quiz.why_uz: Should dan keyin to siz, oddiy fe’l keladi.

quiz.q: Which word has the stress on the second syllable?
quiz.why_uz: en-VI-ron-ment — urg‘u ikkinchi bo‘g‘inda; forest, desert, valley birinchi bo‘g‘inda.
